description: This file contains the main entry point and the implementation of a Flutter application for Android TV. It includes a focus-enabled login screen with username and password fields, customizable theme, focus traversal, and hardware key handling for remote input.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the theme and initial home screen for the application.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget representing a TV-friendly login screen with focus and remote control support.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the login screen's UI state, focus nodes, controllers, and submission logic.

classes.name: _FocusableField
classes.description: Custom widget for a focusable, animated input field with label and hint, adapted for TV navigation.

classes.name: _FocusableButton
classes.description: Custom widget for a focusable, animated button that handles hardware key events and focus styling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the Flutter application, calls runApp with MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for MyApp and other widget classes, constructing the widget tree.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles the mock login submission, updating UI state based on input validation.

methods.name: _onKey
methods.description: Handles hardware key input for triggering form submission on ENTER/SELECT.
